Help and support

Find answers to common questions about using the DAM workspace.

How do I find an asset?

Open Asset Explorer and search by asset name, campaign, or category.

How do I download an asset?

Open an approved asset and use its download action. Available renditions depend on your permissions.

Who can publish content?

Publishing access is controlled by your AEM permissions and editorial workflow.

Contact support

Email support@example.com for additional help.
